column2:
Go up onto the shelf of the mountain;
1b	look [ ... ]
2	I am robbed of the sleep of the gods(?)!
3a	My friend, I saw a dream —
3b	how ominous, how desolate, how tangled!
4	I was grappling with wild bulls of the open land:
5a	one bellowed, and the ground split;
5b	the dust it kicked up butted at the sky.
6	Before it, I — I buckled;
7	then one seized [ ... ] wrapped(?) my arms
8	[ ... ] pulled [me] out [ ... ] by force(?) [ ... ]
9a	my cheek [ ... ] —
9b	he [gav]e me water to drink from his skin.

The [go]d, my friend, against whom we go —
11	is he not the wild bull? — strange, wholly other!
12	The face you saw was shining Šamaš:
13	in hard straits he will take our hand.
14	The one who gave you water to drink from his skin
15-16a	is your god who honors your head, Lugalbanda.
16b-17a	We shall join together and do a single deed —
17b	a work that has never yet been in the <la>nd!
